name: IL-01
label: Safe D

key_factors: Strong Democratic district with +18 partisan lean
Incumbent Jonathan Jackson running with large fundraising edge
Republican challenger underfunded with minimal resources
model.rationale: The +18 Democratic district, Jackson's incumbency and roughly seven-to-one fundraising advantage, and Polymarket pricing at 95% all point to a comfortable Democratic hold with no contrary evidence.
model.watch: Any late polling or outside spending showing unexpected Republican traction would be the first sign of movement.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Jonathan Jackson, the Democratic incumbent, is seeking another term in a Chicago-area district that leans Democratic by about 18 points. He has raised over $418,000 and holds a large cash advantage over Republican Christian Maxwell, who has raised only about $63,000. No independent spending has appeared on either side, and no expert raters have flagged the race as competitive.

Prediction markets put Jackson's chances around 95 percent, and the district's fundamentals suggest a margin in the mid-20s. With no public polling and no signs of a serious Republican campaign, this race is rated Safe Democratic, with Jackson heavily favored to win another term.
